snippet.title: HexBound - Announcement Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Place, rotate, and fit hexagonal pieces into the perfect spots with a satisfying click. The game features a lot of varieties in board design and relaxing music and visuals. 
Wishlist Today!
